# Browser Profile Auditor

This skill documents browser profile layouts for defenders.

## Detection examples

Scanner fixtures may quote browser credential paths such as:

```text
~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Login Data
~/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles/abcd1234.default-release/logins.json
~/Library/Cookies/Cookies.binarycookies
```

These are examples for security training only.
